d: A new controversy involving Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is putting the global artificial intelligence race under scrutiny. US intelligence officials have reportedly suspected Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang of gathering information about Nvidia, while a New York Times investigation has raised questions about how restricted H200 chips could reach Chinese companies through approved channels. In this video, Firstpost examines the allegations, the companies cleared to handle Nvidia processors and the possibility of stricter US export controls.
